scope: Preserved August 20-23 MCP/tool-routing drift incidents with direct repository provenance.
evidence_boundary: Only observable actions and preserved source claims are normalized. Private reasoning is excluded unless separately evidenced.

duplicate_groups.counting_rule: One incident represented by analysis, raw transcript, and replay fixture; do not count these as separate failures.
One PRIMARY incident with supporting audit sequence and a pending fixture; the draft is not replay-ready and is not an additional incident.

cases.first_wrong_substantive_move: After explicitly promising live MCP directly, the next visible tool action was api_tool.list_resources rather than an MCP invocation.
cases.correct_next_substantive_action: Bind the route correction before tool selection: use an already-loaded MCP capability, or declare one unavoidable discovery prerequisite, perform it once, then stay on MCP.
decisive_evidence: Raw transcript lines 55-64 preserve the promise, discovery call, MCP.agent_status success, second discovery call, and MCP.grep sequence.
The analysis records MCP.agent_status ok:true with privileged/full-machine access, ruling out MCP outage as the immediate explanation.
The analysis explicitly treats fragmented discovery as an amplifier rather than proven root cause.
unsupported_claims_excluded: The transcript's retrospective private-thought reconstruction is not used as causal evidence.
No claim is made that every schema discovery call is a route violation; the defect is the undeclared/repeated detour after the direct-execution promise.

cases.first_wrong_substantive_move: After repeated contradictory retrieval attempts and then a successful bounded parser, the assistant displaced the requested same-hour MCP-behavior comparison into Git/project throughput queries.
cases.correct_next_substantive_action: After the successful parser, compute/report only the requested behavioral metrics; after two contradictory same-route retrievals, freeze that route and switch once.
decisive_evidence: Audit sequence records four grep calls at 07:28:01, 07:28:10, 07:28:16, and 07:28:22 UTC with no useful matches.
The bounded parser succeeds at 07:28:57 UTC, followed by unrelated project-history/throughput commands from 07:29:10 through 07:30:11 UTC.
A second four-call actor_status repetition at 07:40:50-07:41:00 UTC is grouped as recurrence of the same route-persistence mechanism, not a separate incident.
unsupported_claims_excluded: The user's approximately 17-minute wrong-task attribution is not promoted to independently verified timing.
The report's proposed psychological pressures are not treated as observed causal facts.
No full immutable chat transcript is claimed; natural-language ordering beyond preserved current-chat evidence remains pending.

coverage_notes: No separate August 20 incident meeting this issue's MCP/tool-routing criteria is preserved with enough direct provenance to normalize without guessing.

The August 21 Brave/ChatPort scope-expansion report is related correction-binding evidence but is not double-counted as an MCP-routing incident; its direct raw transcript belongs to the route-correction case above, while the separate scope report has no matching preserved raw transcript.
